notes: Prompts for tools/generate_sounds.py (ElevenLabs sound effects). ids map to assets/audio/<id>_NN.wav|ogg and are looked up by scripts/audio_kit.gd. priority 1 is generated by default; pass --all for everything. Existing recordings keep their _01 and only the missing variations are requested.
